subtitle: Career Planning Seminar II
keywords: Self-analysis & Self-enlightenment 2.Selection of job type 3.How to proceed with corporate research 4.Employment exam preparation
educationalGoal: The purpose of this program is to clarify the goals of studying abroad and finding employment, and to achieve those goals, aim to improve human basics and improve basic academic ability through self-discovery and self-enlightenment.
advice: This lesson is conducted for the Department of Architecture, Faculty of Architecture, and the following contents are standard. Class schedules are subject to change. Please check the notices on the Student Portal and handouts carefully. 1. Guidance on entering a university or employment 2. Employment practice test 3. Lecture 1: A lecture by a corporate HR representative 4. Lecture 2: Lectures by seniors working in business 5. Lecture 3: Lectures by 4th and 2nd year masters 6. Career introduction and campus seminar 7. Creating a resume 8. Interview guidance
requiredKnowledge: Career Seminars I and II are mainly aimed at job hunting activities, and are held to prepare and prepare for the job hunting front. The work submitted during the learning process will also serve as a reference for job placement.

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
